I have a complete picture of the owner identity implementation. Here is my report.

## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic variant with a dual implementation: a Spring MVC arm and an OfficeFloor "function" arm. Owner identity is derived by a chain of OfficeFloor functions in `.../rest/function/owner/` plus utility classes in `.../util/`, with the derived (read-only) fields computed at response-mapping time in `OwnerMapper`. There is a pending redesign task encoded in the acceptance test (see the end).

The owner-create pipeline order is defined in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: validate -> validatePostcode -> normalizeAddress -> normalizeTelephone -> normalizeEmail -> ensureUniqueIdentity -> ensureCityHasCapacity -> ensureDailyLimit -> build -> resolveRegistrationDate -> **assignCustomerCode** -> assignHousehold -> assignIdentityKey -> countNamesakes -> countHousehold -> flagBulkSignup -> save -> **audit** -> respond.

---

## customerCode (generation)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`
- Current format: `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007`.
- `CITY3` = upper-cased first 3 letters of city; `LAST3` = upper-cased first 3 of last name; `NNNN` = a per-city 4-digit zero-padded **sequence** = `countInCity(...) + 1`.
- `countInCity` iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()` and counts owners whose city matches case-insensitively. Runs after `BuildOwner`, before `SaveOwner`, so it counts only pre-existing owners. Mutates owner via `owner.setCustomerCode(...)`.

Stored on the entity as column `customer_code` in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (field `customerCode`, lines 60-61, getter/setter lines 134-140).

OpenAPI description of this field: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2091-2099 (documents the `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` format, example `SYD-SMI-0007`).

---

## membershipNumber and checkDigit

Both are derived at mapping time (not stored) in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`:
- `membershipNumber(Owner)` (lines 52-57): format `<customerCode>-M<YY>` where YY = `registrationDate.getYear() % 100` (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`); returns null if customerCode or registrationDate absent.
- `checkDigit(Owner)` (lines 63-68): `Luhn.checkDigit(owner.getCustomerCode())`; null if no customerCode.
- Wired via `@Mapping` expressions lines 26-27; also `membershipLevel` (line 28) and `locality` (line 29).

Check-digit algorithm: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Luhn.java` — `checkDigit(String)` ignores non-digits, doubles every second digit right-to-left (subtracting 9 if >9), returns `(10 - sum%10) % 10`.

Membership level: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/MembershipLevels.java` — `of(Owner)` starts at BASE=1, +1 if email present, +1 if `namesakeCount == 0`, capped at MAX=3.

OpenAPI: membershipNumber lines 2133-2139, checkDigit lines 2140-2149, membershipLevel lines 2150-2160.

---

## region code / locality derivation

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CityRegions.java`
- Fixed table: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD; `UNKNOWN` otherwise. `localityOf(String city)`.

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Postcodes.java`
- `FOUR_DIGITS` pattern; `REGION_RANGE`: NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099.
- `regionOf(postcode)`: region whose range contains postcode, else null.
- `localityOf(city, postcode)`: prefers postcode-derived region, falls back to `CityRegions.localityOf(city)`.
- `isWellFormed`, `isValidForCity(city, postcode)`.

Used by `OwnerMapper.locality(Owner)` (line 74-76, calls `Postcodes.localityOf(city, postcode)`) and by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerPostcode.java` (rejects invalid postcode with `InvalidPostcodeException`, 400; postcode is optional). OpenAPI locality description lines 2161-2168.

Note: `OwnerMapper.locality` uses the postcode-preferring `Postcodes.localityOf`, while the OpenAPI text (lines 2163-2165) describes only the city-table derivation.

## Create audit record for owners

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`
- Logs on a dedicated SLF4J logger named `"AUDIT"` at info: `Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}` using `owner.getId()`, `owner.getCustomerCode()`, `owner.getRegistrationDate()`, `MembershipLevels.of(owner)`. Runs after `SaveOwner`; side-effect only.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>',
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Server-derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email omitted as empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal, so
                members of the same household with different telephones are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit (0 to 9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 3. Starts at 1, plus 1
                when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region) resolved from the owner's
                city using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: Derived preferred contact method; 'EMAIL' when the owner has
                an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized
                telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3A7BD3E2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Server-derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email omitted as empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal, so
                members of the same household with different telephones are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3A7BD3E2-M26
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit (0 to 9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 3. Starts at 1, plus 1
                when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region) resolved from the owner's
                city using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: Derived preferred contact method; 'EMAIL' when the owner has
                an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

The full suite is green. Here's what I changed to redesign owner identity to `<REGION>-<HASH8>`.

## Summary

The customer code is now `<REGION>-<HASH8>`: `REGION` is derived solely from the postcode, and `HASH8` is the first 8 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone + lastName`. Sequence numbers are gone, and every value built from the code follows the new identity.

**New units (single responsibilities):**
- `util/Sha256.java` — reusable lower-case hex SHA-256. The hashing was previously inlined in `HouseholdKey`; I extracted it and refactored `HouseholdKey.id()` to reuse it, so there's one digest implementation.
- `util/CustomerCode.java` — owns the identity format: `of(region, telephone, lastName)` builds `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, and `regionOf(code)` reads the region back out (returns `UNKNOWN` when absent). This is the single place the format lives, so downstream consumers derive from it rather than recomputing.

**Changed:**
- `AssignCustomerCode` — dropped the per-city `findAll()` sequence counting (and the repository dependency); now just `Postcodes.regionCode(postcode)` + `CustomerCode.of(...)`. It runs after telephone normalization, so the hash sees the E.164 value.
- `Postcodes` — replaced the now-unused city-fallback `localityOf(city, postcode)` with `regionCode(postcode)` (postcode-only, `UNKNOWN` fallback), matching "region derived from the postcode."
- `OwnerMapper.locality` — now derives from the identity via `CustomerCode.regionOf(customerCode)` instead of re-deriving from city/postcode, so locality "moves to" the new identity.
- `openapi.yml` — updated the `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, and `locality` descriptions/examples.

**Unchanged by design:** `membershipNumber`, `checkDigit` (Luhn over the code's digits), and the create audit record all already read `customerCode`, so they automatically reflect the new identity — the audit log confirmed it: `customerCode=NSW-16E6609E`.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeIsRegionHash` (asserting `[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9A-F]{8}`) and the full suite pass.
